<user_query>
Audit the responsive/mobile CSS of the main pages in the AllTrue frontend. For each page, look for:

1. `overflow` settings on main containers (is horizontal scroll prevented?)
2. Media queries (what breakpoints exist?)
3. Fixed widths that could cause overflow on small screens (e.g. `min-width`, large `width` values, `white-space: nowrap` on wide content)
4. Tables that might overflow their container
5. Grid layouts that might not adapt

Check these files:
- `frontend/src/pages/SmartCalendar.vue` - focus on `.teacher-grid-wrapper`, `.teacher-grid`, `.week-overview-grid`, any `min-width` on columns
- `frontend/src/pages/CourseManagement.vue` - focus on the main table, `.dates-panel`, `.date-chip` wrapping, action buttons
- `frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.vue` - focus on tables and cards
- `frontend/src/pages/DirectorDashboard.vue` - focus on dashboard cards
- `frontend/src/pages/StudentsList.vue` - focus on main table
- `frontend/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue` - focus on tables
- `frontend/src/styles.css` - global responsive styles, body/html overflow settings

For each file, return:
- Which containers have `overflow: hidden` vs `overflow-x: auto` vs no overflow setting
- Any `min-width` values that could cause horizontal scroll
- Whether `box-sizing: border-box` is set globally
- Any tables without responsive wrapper
- Media query breakpoints present

Be thorough - this is about finding why small screens get content clipped.
</user_query>

Searching and reading the listed frontend files for overflow, media queries, min-width, tables, and grid-related CSS.

[REDACTED]

Reading scoped `<style>` sections in each Vue file for complete overflow, grid, and media-query context.

[REDACTED]

Checking `StudentsList.vue` for table markup and wrappers, and `DirectorDashboard` for inline styles on grids.

[REDACTED]

Here is an audit focused on small-screen overflow/clipping, keyed to **absolute paths** under `/home/admin/frontend`.

---

## Global — `/home/admin/frontend/src/styles.css`

| Topic | Finding |
|--------|---------|
| **`box-sizing`** | **`border-box` is global** on `*` (lines 4–7). |
| **`html` / `body` overflow** | **`body` has no `overflow`**. No `overflow-x: hidden` on the document root here—horizontal scroll can still appear if child content is wider than the viewport. |
| **Main shell** | `.main-content`: no overflow set; `min-height: 100vh`; `margin-left: var(--sidebar-w)`. |
| **Tables** | Global `table { width: 100% }` only—**no horizontal scroll wrapper** at the global level. |
| **`overflow: hidden`** | `.brand-logo-container`, `.sidebar-nav .nav-label` (with ellipsis), `body.guide-tour-open` (line 969–970). |
| **`overflow-x: auto`** | ≤640px: `.sidebar-nav` uses `overflow-x: auto` for the bottom tab bar (lines 878–881). |
| **≤900px** | Tighter padding, `--sidebar-w: 246px`, `.mobile-branch-bar` shown (lines 785–825, 828–840). |
| **≤640px** | Bottom nav, `.main-content` bottom padding for tab bar; global `table` smaller padding only—**still no `overflow-x` on tables**. |

---

## `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/SmartCalendar.vue`

**Scoped `box-sizing`:** `.smart-cal-top *`, `.week-view *`, `.teacher-view *` use `box-sizing: border-box` (lines 2551–2555).

### Overflow

| Selector | Value | Note |
|----------|--------|------|
| `.week-view` | `overflow: hidden` (2815) | Outer calendar shell—can **clip** anything that extends past rounded border. |
| `.teacher-grid-wrapper` | **`overflow-x: hidden`** (2817–2819) | **Horizontal scroll is suppressed** here; grid is `width: 100%` with columns that **shrink** (`min-width: 0` on `.teacher-col`), so **content compresses** rather than scrolling; sticky `.time-col` still works. Risk: **very narrow columns / clipped blocks**, not page-level scroll. |
| `.day-tabs-bar` | `overflow-x: auto` (2757–2762) | Good for many day tabs. |
| `.week-overview-grid-wrapper` | **`overflow-x: auto`** (3607–3609) | **Correct** pattern for wide week overview. |
| `.teacher-card`, `.course-block`, various text | `overflow: hidden` + ellipsis | Intentional text clipping. |
| `.context-menu` | `overflow: hidden` (3354–3355) | Local UI. |

### `min-width` / fixed widths (overflow risk)

- Template: `filter-select` **inline `min-width: 160px`** (line 51).
- Styles: `.toolbar-label` `2.2em`, `.month-display` **82px**, `.week-select` **180px**, `.week-select` (generic) **96px**, `.filter-select`/`.filter-input` **120px**, `.day-tab` **72px** (768px: 56px; 640px: 44px), `.week-overview-grid` **`min-width: 700px`** with `.day-col` **`min-width: 90px`** (768px media: grid **600px**, day **75px**).
- **Week overview** forces **~600–700px** minimum width **inside** `.week-overview-grid-wrapper` → **horizontal scroll inside wrapper**, not necessarily whole page (good).

### Grids

- `.teacher-grid`: `display: grid; width: 100%`—adapts by **shrinking columns**; many teachers = narrow columns.
- `.week-overview-grid`: `grid-template-columns: 60px repeat(7, 1fr)` + **`min-width: 700px`**—**does not** become single column on small screens; relies on **wrapper scroll**.

### Tables

- `.teacher-table`, `.room-table`, `.eval-summary-table`—**no** dedicated `overflow-x` wrapper in component; if used inside `.week-view` / cards, width is usually 100% of parent.

### Media queries (this file)

- **1024px**, **768px**, **640px**, **480px** (toolbar/header/day tabs/modals; teacher grid tweaks).
- **768px** block for `.week-overview-grid` (3688–3695).

### Tables / responsive wrapper

- No generic “table-scroll” class; week overview uses **grid + scroll wrapper** instead.

---

## `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/CourseManagement.vue`

### Overflow

| Selector | Value |
|----------|--------|
| `.course-page` | none (width 100%, `max-width: 1280px`) |
| `.table-card` | **`overflow: hidden`** (3304–3307) |
| `.table-wrap` | **`overflow-x: auto`**, **`overflow-y: auto`**, `max-height: 70vh` (3312–3316) |
| `.student-group-card` | `overflow: hidden` |
| `.group-table-wrap` | no x-overflow; **inherits scroll from parent `.table-wrap`** when nested correctly |

### Main table / clipping

- `.course-table` **`min-width: 840px`** (3375–3378)—**forces horizontal scroll inside `.table-wrap`** (good).
- `.table-card { overflow: hidden }` **together with** `.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto }` is a normal pattern; scroll happens **inside** `.table-wrap`.

### `.dates-panel` / `.date-chip`

- `.dates-panel`: `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px` (3754–3762)—**wraps**.
- `.date-chip`: **`white-space: nowrap`** (3764–3771)—each chip is one line; many chips **wrap to new rows**, not one long row (OK).

### Action buttons

- `.col-actions`, `.cell-actions`: **`white-space: nowrap`**, **`min-width: 130px`** (640px: **110px**) (3451–3454, 3709–3712).
- `.action-btns`: **`flex-wrap: nowrap`** (3457–3461)—buttons **stay on one row** → **widens** the table row; mitigated by **table horizontal scroll**.

### Grids

- `.summary-row`: `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))`—adapts.
- 640px: summary **2 columns**; `.form-grid` / `.legacy-grid` **1 column**.

### Media queries

- **`@media (max-width: 640px)`** only (3686–3717) for this page’s layout/table tweaks.

---

## `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.vue`

### Overflow

- **No page-level** overflow on `.att-page`.
- **`.att-table-scroll { overflow-x: auto }`** (700)—tables that use this wrapper get **horizontal scroll** (good).

### Tables / cards

- Main data tables are under `.att-table-scroll` in template (lines 49–50, 150–151, 208–209).
- **Stats:** `.att-stats` is **`grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr)`**; **768px → 2 columns**, **480px** still 2 cols with smaller padding—**no obvious min-width** forcing overflow.

### Fixed / nowrap

- `.att-time-range`: **`white-space: nowrap`** (701)—in a table cell can widen the table → **scroll inside `.att-table-scroll`** (acceptable).
- `.att-search-input` / `.att-filter-select` fixed widths on desktop; **768px → `width: 100%`**.

### Media queries

- **768px**, **480px** (731–746).

---

## `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/DirectorDashboard.vue`

### Overflow

- `.column`: **`overflow-y: auto`**, `max-height: 600px` (568–574)—**no `overflow-x`**; if inner content is wider, it may **clip or spill** depending on browser/grid behavior.
- **No** `overflow-x: auto` on `.dashboard-container` or cards.

### Grids (main risk)

- **`.summary-stats .stats-grid`**: **`grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr)`** (508–512)—**no breakpoint** in this file; on narrow viewports **four tiles share one row** → **very squeezed** stats (not always “clipping” but poor fit).
- **`.dashboard-columns`**: **`repeat(3, 1fr)`** (562–565)—**no responsive stack** in this file → **three narrow columns** on phones; content in `.column` can feel **cramped**; **`.simple-table`** can be **squeezed** or cause **overflow inside** the column without a scroll wrapper.

### Tables

- **`.simple-table`**: `width: 100%`, **no wrapper** with `overflow-x: auto` in template—**three columns**, usually OK, but long teacher names could still stress layout.

### Other

- `.copy-btn`: **`white-space: nowrap`** (720–721) inside **flex** `.alert-item` (`justify-content: space-between`)—can **crowd** the row on very small screens.

### Media queries in this file

- **None**—all responsiveness for dashboard layout would have to come from **global** styles or parent; **this page does not adapt its 4+3 column grids by breakpoint**.

---

## `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/StudentsList.vue`

### Overflow / tables

- **Main student `<table>`** (lines 57–211) sits **directly inside `.card`** with **no** `.table-wrap` / `overflow-x: auto` **in this component**.
- **Expanded** `.course-inner-table` (lines 142–206) is inside `.course-panel` with **no** horizontal scroll wrapper either → **nested wide tables** can force **page-level horizontal scroll** or **clipping** if any ancestor uses `overflow: hidden` (the parent `.card` from global styles does **not** set overflow hidden).

### `min-width` / nowrap

- `.subject-pill`: **`white-space: nowrap`** (1807–1816)—multiple pills use **flex-wrap** on `.subject-tags` (1801–1804), OK.
- Header button “年級升級”: **inline `white-space: nowrap`** (line 49)—can widen header row (minor).
- `.colspan="10"` on expanded row (line 131) vs 9 visible header columns—odd but not a CSS overflow issue per se.

### Media queries

- **None** in the scoped styles read—**students table is not mobile-optimized** in this file.

### `box-sizing`

- Not redeclared in the scoped block shown; **inherits global** `border-box`.

---

## `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/LearningRecordsPage.vue`

### Overflow

- **`.lr-table-card { overflow: hidden }`** (1884–1886).
- **`.lr-table-scroll { overflow-x: auto }`** (1960–1962)—desktop table path **has** horizontal scroll.
- **`.lr-group`**: `overflow: hidden` (1896–1900).
- Modals: `.lr-modal` **max-width 95vw**, **`overflow-y: auto`** (2121–2125).

### Mobile strategy

- **≤640px**: **`.lr-desktop-only { display: none }`**, **`.lr-mobile-only { display: flex }`** (2332–2339)—**table hidden**, **card list** shown—**avoids** main table overflow on phones.
- **Desktop/tablet** still uses scrollable table wrapper—good.

### `min-width` / nowrap

- `.ts-week-label` **110px** (1635–1639); **480px** → **`min-width: 0`** (2536–2539).
- `.ts-time` **48px**; `.lr-actions` **`white-space: nowrap`** (1994–1997).
- `.ts-week`: 7 columns → **768px: 4 columns** → **640px: 1 column**—**adapts well**.

### Media queries

- **900px**, **768px**, **640px**, **480px**—substantial responsive coverage.

### Tables without responsive wrapper

- **Desktop**: table inside **`.lr-table-scroll`**—**has** wrapper.
- **Mobile**: switches to cards—**N/A**.

---

## Root causes summary (why things clip or feel broken on small screens)

1. **`SmartCalendar.vue` — `.teacher-grid-wrapper` uses `overflow-x: hidden`** while relying on a **shrinking grid**; dense schedules **clip inside cells** rather than allowing horizontal panning of the whole grid (unlike week overview, which uses **`overflow-x: auto`** + **`min-width`** on the grid).
2. **`SmartCalendar.vue` — `.week-view { overflow: hidden }`** can reinforce **clipping** at the card edge.
3. **`DirectorDashboard.vue` — fixed 4-column stats + 3-column dashboard** with **no media queries** in-file → **severe squeezing** on small screens; **no `overflow-x: auto`** on columns/tables if content runs wide.
4. **`StudentsList.vue` — no horizontal scroll wrapper** around the main table or **course-inner-table** → **likely full-page horizontal scroll** or awkward layout on phones.
5. **`styles.css`** does not set **`overflow-x: hidden` on `html/body`**; clipping usually comes from **component-level `overflow: hidden`** (e.g. calendar week view, table cards) **without** an inner scroll region.

**`box-sizing: border-box`:** set **globally** in `/home/admin/frontend/src/styles.css` (`*` selector). Individual pages may restate it locally (e.g. SmartCalendar scoped).
